calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-11-28'

SELECT 
  DATE(order_ts_utc) as order_date,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) >= '2025-11-26' AND DATE(order_ts_utc) <= '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY DATE(order_ts_utc)
ORDER BY order_date

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_timestamps,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as unique_members,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as guest_orders,
  MIN(order_ts_utc) as earliest_order,
  MAX(order_ts_utc) as latest_order
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-11-28'
